root.label: PolitiFact ruling on Sununu claim about Pappas tax votes

events.label: PolitiFact ruling on Sununu claim about Pappas tax votes

slots.name: state tax votes
slots.sentence: In the House, Democrat Rep. Chris Pappas voted against President Donald Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act in 2025, and he voted for higher taxes or against lower taxes three times as a state legislator more than two decades ago.

slots.name: procedural votes per bill
slots.sentence: The list cites 16 distinct congressional bills but counts an average of more than three procedural votes per bill in its overall tally.

slots.name: HEROES spending
slots.sentence: Among other votes Sununu’s campaign cited were votes on the HEROES Act, a $3 trillion COVID-19 relief measure proposed in 2020 that Pappas voted for but didn’t become law.

slots.name: infrastructure allocation
slots.sentence: Sununu’s campaign also included the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act of 2022, known as the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. This law allocated $1.2 trillion for transportation and infrastructure spending; Pappas voted for it.

slots.name: retirement bill margin
slots.sentence: Another law on the list that Pappas voted for, the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, can be fairly described as a tax-focused measure. It increased taxes on corporations, especially the biggest corporations, but it also enacted tax breaks for clean energy usage in homes and automobiles.

slots.name: tax relief bill margin
slots.sentence: One action Pappas voted for, the Securing a Strong Retirement Act of 2022, passed the House by a 414-5 margin.

slots.name: retirement enhancement margin
slots.sentence: Another, the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act of 2024, passed by a 357-70 margin.

slots.name: OBBB counted votes
slots.sentence: And the Setting Every Community Up for Retirement Enhancement Act of 2019 passed by a 417-3 margin.

slots.name: precursor votes counted
slots.sentence: The measure passed with mostly Republican support, but such measures are rhetorical and have no practical effect.

slots.name: homebuyer tax credit
slots.sentence: The Sununu campaign counts six total votes, including procedural votes, against the bill; one of those is Pappas’ vote against final passage.

slots.name: fact check rating
slots.sentence: Pappas also introduced legislation to ban states from taxing a nonresident’s income earned when they were not physically present in that state; sponsored legislation to provide a refundable tax credit for people struggling with high energy costs; and co-sponsored a bill to provide a 10% tax credit for first-time homebuyers.

slots.name: claimed tax votes
slots.sentence: The list of 68 votes cited by Republican John Sununu’s Senate campaign is inflated by counting procedural votes and bills that largely aren’t about taxes.
